provenance.paper_title: PathNavigate: A Training-Free Pathology Agent with Surprise-Guided Scan and Shared Slide Memory for Whole-Slide Image VQA

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Frozen pathology features are accumulated into a slide-specific online memory used for scan and readout.

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: The memory produces a spatial surprise field and candidate pool before question-conditioned target selection.
During operation, PathNavigate applies a fixed operational optimization objective to shared slide feature memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, PathNavigate applies progressive decay of stored importance or retention to shared slide feature memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (shared slide feature memory) changes through a fixed operational optimization objective, progressive decay of stored importance or retention; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
